labs.title: Broken Access Control
labs.description: Learn how authorization flaws allow unauthorized users to view, tamper with, or delete sensitive data.
labs.short_description: Insecure Direct Object References and multi-tenant boundary bypass.
learning_objectives: Identify flawed object-level access controls
Audit multi-tenant boundary isolation
Implement server-side authorization enforcement

labs.title: Security Misconfiguration
labs.description: Investigate default credentials, exposed debug interfaces, and unauthenticated directory listings leaking sensitive backups.
labs.short_description: Default credentials, diagnostic endpoints, and backup exposures.
learning_objectives: Identify exposed debug and diagnostic endpoints
Detect dangerous unauthenticated directory browsing
Harden default server credentials and configs

labs.title: Software Supply Chain Failures
labs.description: Understand risks from unverified third-party dependencies, malicious package scripts, and vulnerable build artifacts.
labs.short_description: Dependency poisoning, unpinned telemetry packages, and lockfile tampering.
learning_objectives: Analyze compromised package manifests and lockfiles
Trace unauthorized credential exfiltration scripts
Implement cryptographic package provenance verification

labs.title: Cryptographic Failures
labs.description: Explore the risks of legacy broken hashes (MD5), hardcoded encryption keys, and sensitive data leakage.
labs.short_description: Broken MD5 hashes, salt omissions, and rainbow table reversing.
learning_objectives: Recognize obsolete cryptographic algorithms
Understand how unsalted hashes succumb to precomputed tables
Deploy modern password hashing algorithms (Argon2/bcrypt)

labs.title: Injection
labs.description: Understand SQL injection root causes, malicious query manipulation, and parameterized query remediation.
labs.short_description: SQL query manipulation, string escaping breakout, and UNION extraction.
learning_objectives: Distinguish data from query syntax execution
Execute UNION-based database schema exfiltration
Refactor raw SQL strings into prepared statements

labs.title: Insecure Design
labs.description: Analyze flawed business logic, unverified workflow state transitions, and missing architectural security controls.
labs.short_description: Flawed procurement state transitions and missing business logic controls.
learning_objectives: Differentiate design flaws from implementation vulnerabilities
Detect illegal state transitions in enterprise workflows
Establish architectural security invariants in business logic

labs.title: Authentication Failures
labs.description: Explore how weak credential requirements, lack of brute-force protection, and session fixation lead to account takeover.
labs.short_description: Missing lockout mechanisms, predictable PINs, and automated credential stuffing.
learning_objectives: Assess authentication mechanisms against automated guessing
Identify failure modes of unrestricted login endpoints
Implement multi-layered rate limiting and progressive delays

labs.title: Software or Data Integrity Failures
labs.description: Understand vulnerabilities from accepting unverified, untrusted software or configuration artifacts without cryptographic signatures.
labs.short_description: Unsigned firmware configurations and missing digital signature verification.
learning_objectives: Evaluate the risks of accepting untrusted configuration updates
Demonstrate code/config tampering without integrity checks
Implement asymmetric signature verification for payload ingestion

labs.title: Security Logging & Alerting Failures
labs.description: Discover how insufficient security telemetry, missing audit trails, and silent failures prevent incident detection.
labs.short_description: Silent security incidents, missing privilege escalation logs, and audit blindness.
learning_objectives: Audit high-privilege operations for logging coverage
Identify blind spots that permit undetected adversary movement
Design tamper-evident structured security audit events

labs.title: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
labs.description: Examine dangerous fail-open exception handling where upstream service errors accidentally bypass authorization boundaries.
labs.short_description: Fail-open exception handling allowing unauthorized security gate traversal.
learning_objectives: Identify fail-open security flaws in exception handling blocks
Induce upstream failure states that bypass authorization checks
Enforce strict fail-closed defaults across all boundary guards
